name: Macroalgae (kelps)
description: Kelp beds of the shallow subtidal zone (0-20 m). Functional group pooling the canopy and understory kelps - the source reports Agarum cribrosum and Laminaria saccharina as over 90% of biomass, with Nereocystis luetkeana beds on exposed sites - measured together by the source study. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in tonnes wet weight per km2, from Table 23 of the source.
